Rooted in tradition. Growing with care.

Oliveco, since 1986.

Our beginnings

Established in 1986, Oliveco brings together Myanmar traditional cosmetic knowledge, Indian Ayurvedic cosmetic methods and modern research and manufacturing.

Inspired by local botanicals

Our company profile describes the use of locally found aloe vera, neem, thanaka and herbs across our cosmetic ranges. These traditions inform our approach to everyday beauty and care.

Care in many forms

The profile includes face cleansing cream, facial foam, facial mask with neem extract, green tea extract treatment hair tonic, thanaka liquid makeup and aloe vera liquid makeup. Today, explore our catalogue of beauty, personal care, household and medical products, with our Mandalay team ready to answer your questions.

Our story is a shared one.

Behind the products are the people who bring Oliveco to life. These photographs bring that part of our story into view: colleagues, familiar faces and time spent together.

Care, on the move.

Our company photographs also tell a story beyond the building. Oliveco’s branded vehicles and the people beside them show another part of the everyday work behind our products.

More than the working day.

There is room in our story for gathering and tradition, too. A shared occasion, a room full of colleagues and a quiet moment of respect are part of the memories we keep together.

The story continues, every day.
